subject: Media Literacy
title: The Future of Media
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Future of Media usable.

hook.text: VR headsets, AI anchors, and neural interfaces — the next media revolution is already beginning.

buildup.text: Each media revolution has expanded reach and reduced the gap between creation and consumption.

discovery.text: The pattern is clear: every new medium starts open, gets commercialized, then gets regulated.

twist.text: AI may break this pattern entirely — when machines create and consume content, who is the audience?

climax.text: Understanding media history is the best preparation for whatever comes next.

punchline.text: The medium changes. The pattern repeats.

quiz.question: What pattern has every new medium followed historically?
